blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — German lender Deutsche Bank raised its full-year inflation forecast for the Philippines to 5.9 percent following the faster-than-expected October consumer price jump, though it maintained that the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has little need to raise interest rates again as price pressures remain concentrated rather than broad-based.
